items.verse: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
items.verseEn: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
And at the sky - how it is raised?

categories.name: أَلْفَاظُ الْمَاءِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Terms for Water in the Quran

items.verse: رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًۭا
items.verseEn: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.

items.verse: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
items.verseEn: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

items.verse: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًۭا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًۭا وَصِهْرًۭا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًۭا
items.verseEn: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].

categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتُ الْعَقَبَةِ فِي سُورَةِ الْبَلَدِ
categories.nameEn: The Steep Pass and Its Demands in Surah Al-Balad

items.verseEn: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
It is the freeing of a slave

items.verse: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
items.verseEn: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

items.verse: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
items.verseEn: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

categories.name: مُؤَنَّثَاتٌ بِلَا تَاءٍ مَرْبُوطَةٍ
categories.nameEn: Feminine Nouns Without Taa Marbuta in the Quran

items.verse: قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ سُنَنٌۭ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
items.verseEn: Similar situations [as yours] have passed on before you, so proceed throughout the earth and observe how was the end of those who denied.

items.verse: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ مُّحْضَرًۭا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًۭا ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
items.verseEn: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allāh warns you of Himself, and Allāh is Kind to [His] servants."

items.verse: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
items.verseEn: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
It is a Fire, intensely hot.

harf.hint: The opposite of falsehood; what is true and just.
harf.arabicVerse: فَذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ إِلَّا ٱلضَّلَـٰلُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
harf.verse: 10:32 - For that is Allāh, your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted?

deduction.title: The Cursed Hands
deduction.intro: You stand in the winding alleys of ancient Makkah, where a soul of influence and wealth once turned away from the call of truth. This figure's story is a stark reminder that ties of blood cannot overcome the chains of pride. Who is this one whose name echoes with the fire that awaits?
clues: I walked the streets of Makkah with a pride that blinded me to the truth, though the messenger was of my own blood.
My possessions were vast, but they became a curse rather than a shield.
The book of guidance speaks of my ruin, declaring that my hands and my person will perish.
My spouse joined my campaign of enmity, gathering thorns to spread on the path of the one who called to Allah.
On the day of judgment, I will be plunged into a fire of blazing flame, and my spouse will have a rope of palm fiber around the neck.
I am known by a name that means 'father of flame' — a name that foretells my eternal abode.

trial.label: Key Trial or Event
options: Opposed the Prophet and was cursed in the Quran
Led an army to destroy the Kaaba
Attempted to kill the Prophet by throwing stones
Refused to believe in the splitting of the moon
Built a tower to reach the heavens
trial.answer: Opposed the Prophet and was cursed in the Quran

outcome.label: Outcome
options: He will enter the blazing Fire, and his wealth will not avail him
He repented and became a believer
He was taken up to the heavens
outcome.answer: He will enter the blazing Fire, and his wealth will not avail him

deduction.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
deduction.verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)

scramble.hint: A powerful command of tawakkul (reliance on Allah) — reminding believers that placing trust in Allah alone is enough, for He suffices as the ultimate Protector and Disposer of all affairs.
scramble.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًۭا
scramble.verseEn: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
